name: afya_voice_intake_agent
description: Multilingual clinical extraction from CHV voice recordings. Supports Dholuo, Swahili, Kikuyu, Somali, English.

tools.name: extract_clinical_data
tools.description: Extract structured clinical data (syndrome, triage, symptoms) from base64-encoded audio. Supports multi-turn clarification.

parameters.audio_base64: string (required) — base64-encoded WAV or WebM audio
parameters.clarification_answers: array[string] (optional) — CHV answers to clarification questions

tools.name: clarify_extraction
tools.description: Refine a previous extraction with a CHV clarification answer (second-pass NLP).

parameters.clarification_answer: string (required) — CHV's answer to the clarification question
